title: Rav Yaakov, grandson of Rav Acha bar Yaakov
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rav Yaakov, son of the daughter of Rav Acha bar Yaakov.

Sotah 49a relates that his grandfather Rav Acha bar Yaakov raised him. Once his grandfather asked him for water; he replied, “I am not your son.” Hence the saying, “Raise, raise—I'm your daughter's son.”

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Sotah 49a explicitly calls the grandson Rav Yaakov and identifies him as Rav Acha bar Yaakov’s daughter’s son. His grandfather requests water; the grandson replies, “I am not your son.”
